description: This file contains a function 'makeOpenAIImageEditsRequest' that interfaces with the OpenAI API to perform image edits. It handles multiple images, manages API requests, processes responses, updates UI components, and handles errors. It is part of a React/Next.js project setup.

methods.name: makeOpenAIImageEditsRequest
methods.description: Asynchronously sends images to OpenAI's API for editing given a prompt and model, processes the response to extract image URLs or base64 data, updates UI, and handles errors.
